name: Kunisaki (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kunisaki city emblem in green, light blue and orange: a green ring open at the fly enclosing a light blue wave and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kunisaki, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 2006.
